title: Native TLS key generation: timeout told apart from missing openssl, no flaky Windows CI
goal: The Windows job does not fail on a slow openssl
acceptance: A committed test fails first: a slow key generation is reported as a timeout, not as missing openssl
The Windows job passes without reruns
privacy: Neutral fixtures and invented data only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-18: separate timeout from spawn failure, raise the bound, one test.
